info.title: Showpass Organizer API
info.description: Events and ticket type operations available to scoped Showpass organizer API keys.

get.description: Lists events for the key organization. Requires a key bound to the organization and an employee with Manage Events or All Access. Nested password data also requires effective passwords:read access. Schedule messages can depend on the event, organization and request language. By default the list is limited to viewable statuses and excludes recurring parents. Use status and recurrence filters to select other supported event records. Use q to search by name. Order by ends_on, starts_on or id, with a leading minus for descending order.

An event with protected sales, remaining recurring children, or membership event batches can be rejected.
